strategies.summary: Rebook onto an earlier same-day flight and keep the downstream chain

toolRequests.purpose: check change fees before proposing rebooking

assumptions: an earlier same-day option exists with available seats
uncertainties: seat availability on earlier options is unverified
expectedOutcomes: downstream arrivals remain within required windows

strategies.summary: Hold the current itinerary and adjust downstream timing

toolRequests.purpose: estimate ground transport duration under disruption

assumptions: downstream items tolerate a late arrival
uncertainties: downstream tolerance is not yet verified

toolRequests.purpose: verify the leading replacement offer before ranking

assumptions: impact assessment reflects the latest signal

uncertainties.statement: replacement flight availability is not yet confirmed

rationale: Two materially different strategies: rebook earlier vs hold and adjust; both need read-only verification before ranking.
